atomic_facts.fact: France issued an arrest warrant for Carlos Ghosn.
The arrest warrant was issued on 2026-09-29.
Carlos Ghosn is being tried in absentia in the Paris corruption trial.
The trial was ongoing as of September 2026.
French prosecutors sought a four-year prison sentence for Carlos Ghosn.
French prosecutors sought a 375,000-euro fine for Carlos Ghosn.
These sentencing requests were made in the Paris trial.
Ghosn served as CEO of Nissan from June 2001 until April 2017.
Ghosn served as CEO of Renault from May 2005.
Ghosn served as Chairman of the Renault-Nissan Alliance BV from Jan 2002 to Oct 2018.
